items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Yeah and Trent brought the band to Little Rock and stayed around Little Rock so that I could be with the band.

ctx.x: Fort Smith, right. Well after we played Stem Beach that summer I had to still go back to school. Yeah and Trent brought the band to Little Rock and stayed around Little Rock so that I could be with the band. I appreciated it very much.
HE COULD AFFORD TO STAY AROUND THERE EVEN THOUGH THERE WASN'T THAT MUCH WORK?
